text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(Now, then.
If I were to estimate this experiment's
progress… 20%, perhaps?
It seems I need a catalyst to accelerate 
the process. The more reactive, the better,
of course.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why, hello,
Fuji-kun! Just who I wanted to see!
I do hope you'll 
give me your support in the basket dodgeball
event. 
Pokke-kun's going to be my opponent,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm your captain,
so of course I'll be cheering you on… 
But don't be sly,
Tachyon. You're up to something,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Perish the thought!
Is it so hard to believe I simply want to 
hear your cheers? Yes,
watch me to your heart's content. 
——And don't take your eyes off me.

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Now it's time for the basket dodgeball event!
Like the classic ball-toss game,
each team's thrower will try to land
balls 
in the basket to earn points, but——

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
There's the added twist that the basket's
attached to a member of the other team,
who'll be constantly on the move!
Which of 
our two teams will come out on top in this
contest of speed!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's see,
the white team won the obstacle race and
the tug-of-war. My oh my,
it seems if you drop the ball here, we'll 
be running away with the lead～

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Indeed, you cannot afford to lose, now can you, my good thrower Pokke-kun? Do you think you'll be able to catch me? Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You always love running your damn mouth,
huh? 
Shut the hell up and let's start already!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
<i>ORAORAORAORAORAORAORAORAORAOAAAAAA!!</i
>
Take that, Tachyon!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Pokke-kun!
Need I remind you what event this is?! 
Your goal is to land the balls in the basket,
not on me! 
Just where do you think you're aiming?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry, I see the problem! 
Am I moving far too fast for your poor little
eyes to keep up?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
HA! Like hell you are!! 
——I'm gonna make you stop dead in your
tracks, 
little miss science freak!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Did I not just tell you about your aim, my good former delinquent? Hmm, I see, I see——

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll admit that you've earned the coveted
title of the "strongest". 
But the throne of the "fastest" is still up
for grabs—— 
So you won't mind if I take it,
now will you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Shut the hell up.
You wanna be the fastest? 
Enough jokes.
I'm sure as hell not letting you. 
You're not even getting close.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget! 
I'm Jungle Pocket, and I'm the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
……Heh heh. 
Yes… I suppose you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(Of course you would. 
——You have no limits, after all.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You conquered the Japanese Derby,
the stage of every 
Umamusume's dreams. You won the Japan Cup,
tearing 
T.M. Opera O from her throne at the peak.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And yet,
your animalistic greed refuses to be satisfied.
Like an 
untameable beast… Like a child who simply
wants without 
reservation… You continue to pursue the
title of the "strongest".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You would go so far as to bare your fangs
at your beloved 
mentor.
Even my cheapest instigation is enough to
set you off.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You are limitless. 
Always, to the point of driving me mad——

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
……Yes, it drives me mad,
how infinite your potential is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So I will consume you. Every one of you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I will bind you all into polymers,
and raise your molecules to an 
excited state.
I will load you all into my sample
concentrator, 
to synthesize a solution allowing me to
surpass even light itself!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Evolve to your heart's content for me,
Pokke-kun. 
Clash with her at full force for me,
Fuji-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Tap-kun, and Digital-kun, too. Yes,
every one of you in this little 
bottle garden we call Tracen Academy,
so full of infinite 
possibilities… I will swallow you all
whole——

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And I will reach the unreachable beyond!! With my own two legs!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAAAAAAAAHH SHUT THE HELL UP!!! YOU'RE NOT GOING ANYWHERE, TACHYON!!!!

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-What unbelievable acceleration!
And just as unbelievable 
pursuit! Agnes Tachyon dashes away,
but Jungle Pocket 
is right on her tail!

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
They're like two beasts ripping their teeth
into each other!! 
This is one! Heated! Battle!

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
……53! ……54! …55!! 
The team with the most balls in the basket
is… 
The white team!!

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It was close! So close!
But the red team fell just one inch 
short!
The white team takes the win at basket
dodgeball!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
………AAAAAAGH! Dammit!! 
Now we're really behind on points…!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmmm……Aren't you in a pickle now, Pokke-kun! Oh yes, you're doomed～ So very doomed～

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
……Save it.
We're gonna turn this thing around. 
Just watch us.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm not givin' up.
Doesn't matter where I am or what 
I'm doing, I'm gonna kick some ass…!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ……Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
AH! Welcome back Tachyon-shan……!1! 
Huge congratulations on your epic win!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now right this way,
right this way. I've prepared a 
extra-fluffy cushion and super-duper sweet
honey lemonade 
just for you…!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why, you're as prepared as ever,
Digital-kun. I couldn't ask 
for a more useful roommate.
I'll go ahead and make the most 
of your amenities,
then. I am simply exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That beast is quite the handful when she
gets riled up… 
Isn't she, Fuji-kun?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ……Haha. Yeah, she is.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know, I really do. 
——I always have.
